content.title: Jack Osbourne Has a Baby Girl. Her Heavy Metal Name is the Ultimate Tribute to Ozzy
content.text: Ozzy Osbourne’s legacy will live on with his newborn granddaughter.The late singer’s son Jack Osbourne revealed March 11 on Instagram that he had welcomed a baby daughter that he named Ozzy.“Introducing Ozzy Matilda Osbourne,” he captioned a brief video of her, alongside a card saying she was born March 5, weighing 7 pounds, 12 ounces and measuring 19 inches. The post was also shared by Osbourne’s wife, Aree Osbourne, and his mother, Sharon Osbourne.Jack Osbourne, 40, is now a father of five girls. He shares daughters Pearl, 13, Andy, 10, and Minnie, 8, with ex-wife Lisa Stelly. He and Aree Osbourne are also parents to Maple, 3.Ozzy Osbourne died in July 2025 at the age of 76, reportedly as a result of a heart attack.“It is with more sadness than mere words can convey that we have to report that our beloved Ozzy Osbourne has passed away this morning,” read a statement from Osbourne's family. Osbourne had six kids in total. He shared three — Jack Osbourne, Kelly Osbourne and Aimee Osbourne — with wife Sharon. His three kids with ex-wife Thelma Riley are Louis Osbourne, Jessica Osbourne and Elliot Kingsley, Thelma Riley's son from a previous relationship.“He was with his family and surrounded by love. We ask everyone to respect our family privacy at this time,” the statement continued.Two weeks after Osbourne’s death, Jack Osbourne mourned his loss him in an Instagram post.“He was so many things to so many people, but I was so lucky and blessed to be apart of a very small group that got to call him ‘Dad,’” he wrote, in part. “My heart is full of so much sadness and sorrow, but also so much love and gratitude. I got 14,501 days with that man and I know that is such a blessing.”
